tagline: Connected car and automotive electronics innovation leader
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of profitability and operational efficiency gains, reflecting cost reductions and efficiency improvements despite pricing pressures

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin increased due to cost reductions and operational improvements

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Net sales increased by 10% in 2025 due to the acquisition of VOXX. Organic sales at Gentex ($2.27B) declined by 2% due to pricing and reduced export demand to China

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of sales
kpis.description: R&D expenses increased by 12% in 2025, primarily due to the acquisition of VOXX which contributed $18.0 million. R&D represents 8% of sales

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total operating expenses as a percentage of sales
kpis.description: Operating expenses increased by 26% in 2025, primarily due to the acquisition of VOXX, restructuring charges ($11.6M in severance costs), and integration costs

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to Gentex as a percentage of sales
kpis.description: Net income declined by 5% in 2025, decreasing from 17.5% to 15.2% of sales, due to investment losses ($14.1M impairments) and credit reserves

kpis.name: FDM Unit Shipments Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth rate of FDM unit shipments
kpis.description: FDM unit shipments declined by 6% in 2025 compared to 2024, despite FDM's relative growth within the company's product portfolio

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $2.534B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $0.474B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Dependence on the cyclical automotive industry
risks.score_rationale: The risk ranks highest among cited factors, with 89% of sales tied to the automotive sector. The language emphasizes volatility in production, shortages, and plant closures. Recurrence and intensity are highlighted, with direct impact on results. High weighting for a cyclical industrial sector.

risks.title: Potential loss of key customers
risks.score_rationale: Three customers (Toyota, VW, GM) each represent more than 10% of revenue. The document specifies that losing any one would have a material adverse effect. Central placement in the 10-K and strong language justify severity.

risks.title: Pricing and margin pressures
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of persistent pricing pressures in the text, with a proven negative impact on margins. Language is firm. Less existential than customer loss, but structural. Linked to customer and competitor pressure.

risks.title: Component shortages and supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned as current and recurring. Direct impact on deliveries and production. Strong language documenting observed effects. Supply chain disruptions regularly affect operations.

risks.title: Technological evolution: cameras vs mirrors
risks.score_rationale: The text acknowledges camera-monitor systems may replace mirrors, with regulations evolving in China, Europe, and Japan. The company admits to increasing competitive risk. Disruptive threat to core business.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and valuation risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk tied to external growth strategy. The text mentions integration difficulties, synergy realization, and financing challenges. Language is cautious. Less existential than operational risks, but important for growth trajectory.

risks.title: Tariffs and geopolitical tensions
risks.score_rationale: Tariffs between the U.S., China, Mexico, and Canada are explicitly cited as increasing costs and harming competitiveness. Prominent placement in the text. Reciprocal trade measures directly affected 2025 results.

ai_positioning.summary: Company GNTX does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 annual report.
